No chimney, pipe, plants, furniture, room, text, controls, icons or borders. Only the brick structure and a shallow patch of pencil floor tiles. Preserve the playful, very visibly hand-colored/crayon medium of reference. Not a smooth vector icon, not photorealism, no shadow outside illustration.
